versions.content: Read Dynamically defined DID authentication check On re- ception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), the Dcm shall check for all requested DIDs inside the range 0xF200-0xF3FF if the content is based of DIDs or parts of DIDs that are authenticated and read the data identifiers only if: • a DcmDspDidReadRole is configured for those DIDs and the verification accord- ing to [SWS_Dcm_01522] was successful or • the active white list on that connection has for each requested DID one entry with read access that matches those DIDs. 134 of 683  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 18: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticCommunicationManager Specification of Diagnostic Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R19-11
